title: Robust Hate Speech Detection in Social Media: A Cross-Dataset Empirical Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Performing cross-dataset evaluations by training language models on individual hate speech datasets and testing them on other out-of-distribution datasets to highlight deficiencies in generalization and over-fitting to dataset-specific characteristics.
Evaluating hate speech detection performance (using macro-averaged F1 scores) on text specifically targeting race, ethnicity, or immigration status within a unified multiclass dataset.
Evaluating hate speech detection performance (using macro-averaged F1 scores) on text specifically targeting gender (sexism) within a unified multiclass dataset.

Evaluating hate speech detection performance (using macro-averaged F1 scores) on text specifically targeting sexual orientation within a unified multiclass dataset and an independently constructed test set.
Evaluating hate speech detection performance (using macro-averaged F1 scores) on text specifically targeting disabilities within a unified multiclass dataset.
Evaluating hate speech detection performance (using macro-averaged F1 scores) on text specifically targeting religious groups within a unified multiclass dataset.
